classification: Current-research historical context; latest-reported evidence, not an as-released backtest or forecasts.

methodology.selection: Up to ten complete fiscal years; an eleventh preceding annual observation supports growth and beginning-capital denominators. Missing or incomparable years are never invented. Latest eligible annual filing per period/concept, through cutoff; can include recasts. Quarter and YTD facts excluded.
methodology.capitalProxy: Book equity + explicitly mapped debt − cash and cash equivalents. Not adjusted invested capital: does not deduct marketable securities or capitalize R&D, normalize leases, remove goodwill, or validate all debt/claims.
methodology.reinvestmentWarning: Historical total sales/book-capital is a stock ratio. The model uses incremental revenue/reinvestment. Neither that stock ratio nor changes in book capital are a direct measurement of economic marginal reinvestment.
methodology.taxWarning: Tax/pretax income only when pretax income > 0. Tax benefits or >100% rates shown but excluded from normal ranges/ROIC. Effective accounting tax is not a forecast marginal cash-tax rate; no NOL schedule.
methodology.rangeWarning: Observed min/median/max of available observations are descriptive, not recommended ranges or prediction intervals.
methodology.temporalWarning: History uses latest-reported data and must not be used to assert what was known at an earlier date.

cautions: Book capital is equity plus mapped debt minus cash. It is an accounting proxy, not adjusted invested capital; missing amounts are never zero-filled.

FY2017 includes a partial year of EMC after the September 2016 merger; years through FY2019 include VMware, while FY2020 onward is recast continuing operations excluding VMware. Growth across incompatible scope is unavailable.
VMware was spun off in November 2021. FY2020-FY2021 closing capital and FY2022 opening capital can retain VMware while earnings exclude it; affected capital ratios are excluded from ranges.

Consolidated book capital includes DFS customer-financing assets and debt. Buybacks, negative equity, large trade payables and supplier finance make historical book ratios poor direct forecasts of required reinvestment.
Fiscal 2026 includes the first quarter disposal of Secureworks and VMware resale run-off. Recent AI-server growth and working-capital intensity can differ sharply from historical averages.

cautions: Book capital is equity plus mapped debt minus cash. It is an accounting proxy, not adjusted invested capital; missing amounts are never zero-filled.
Ten real annual years (FY2016–FY2025) are available. The IPO prospectus starts audited operating statements in FY2016; no FY2015 opening observation is manufactured.
FY2016/2017 revised and FY2018 restated amounts supersede stale Company Facts values where necessary. FY2016 pretax income and FY2016/2017 complete debt remain unknown.
All available annual pretax results are losses, so historical effective tax rates and tax-based ROIC are unavailable; the forward tax assumption is an analyst input.
Debt includes consolidated project non-recourse borrowing and financing obligations. The FY2019 capital-lease schedule overlaps managed-services financing obligations and is not added twice.

Historical capital ratios include consolidated NCI and project assets, exclude separately classified redeemable preferred stock, and are imperfect proxies for marginal reinvestment in new AI/data-center deployments.
